diagnosis.headline: Failure mode is DETECTION (sensitivity), not DELINEATION (precision).
diagnosis.when_it_detects: Dice 0.705, median centroid error 0.24 px (~0.17 mm), predicted/true area ratio 1.06 - the outline is close to the radiologist consensus.
diagnosis.when_it_misses: Median peak probability inside the true nodule is 0.0003, and 97% of misses are below 0.05. The model produces essentially NO response, rather than a weak one.
diagnosis.threshold_is_not_the_fix: Sweeping the operating threshold from 0.05 to 0.55 on validation moved the detection rate by less than 3 points (0.574 -> 0.549). The misses cannot be recovered by lowering the threshold.
diagnosis.likely_cause: 2D single-slice inference. A nodule that is unambiguous when a radiologist scrolls through the volume can be indistinguishable from a vessel cross-section in one slice. The model also saw only 35 training patients.
what_would_fix_it: 3D or multi-slice input (2.5D stacking of adjacent slices)
more annotated patients - the full LIDC collection has ~1000
a detection-first architecture (e.g. nodule candidate proposal + false-positive reduction) rather than pure semantic segmentation
